34: def safe_repo_rel(root, relative):
35:     """Validate canonical REL and every component before any byte read."""
36:     require(isinstance(relative, str) and relative and "\\" not in relative
37:             and not relative.startswith("/") and not PureWindowsPath(relative).drive
38:             and ":" not in relative and "//" not in relative
39:             and all(piece not in ("", ".", "..") for piece in relative.split("/")),
40:             "BAD_CANONICAL_REL")
41:     root = root.resolve(strict=True)
42:     path = root
43:     for piece in relative.split("/"):
44:         path = path / piece
45:         item = path.lstat()
46:         require(not path.is_symlink() and not getattr(path, "is_junction", lambda: False)()
47:                 and not (getattr(item, "st_file_attributes", 0) &
48:                          getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)),
49:                 "REF_ALIAS_OR_REPARSE")
50:     resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
51:     require(root in resolved.parents and resolved.relative_to(root).as_posix() == relative,
52:             "FOREIGN_OR_ALIAS_REF")
53:     return resolved

56: def safe_repo_pin(root, claim):
57:     require(isinstance(claim, dict) and set(claim) == {"path", "sha256", "bytes"}
58:             and isinstance(claim.get("sha256"), str)
59:             and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", claim["sha256"])
60:             and type(claim.get("bytes")) is int and claim["bytes"] >= 0,
61:             "TYPED_REF_REQUIRED")
62:     path = safe_repo_rel(root, claim["path"])
63:     require(path.is_file(), "REF_NOT_REGULAR_FILE")
64:     raw = path.read_bytes()
65:     require(digest(raw) == claim["sha256"] and len(raw) == claim["bytes"],
66:             "REF_BYTES_CHANGED")
67:     return path, raw

72:     run_id = report.get("run_id")

84:                            {"start", "run", "pause", "cont", "pass", "fail", "skip", "output", "bench"}

86:     actions = [(e.get("Action"), e.get("Test")) for e in events if e.get("Test") in selected]
87:     require(sorted(t for a, t in actions if a == "pass") == sorted(selected)
88:             and not any(a in {"fail", "skip"} for a, _ in actions), "GO_TEST_ROSTER_NOT_PASS")
89:     require(not any(e.get("Test") and e["Test"] not in selected and e.get("Action") in {"pass", "fail", "skip"}

104:             and all(x.get("run_id") == run_id and x.get("status") == "PASS" for x in assertions),
105:             "STDOUT_ASSERTION_REPLAY_MISMATCH")
106:     locked_path = root / "execution/toolchains/locked.json"
107:     locked_raw = locked_path.read_bytes()
108:     locked = json.loads(locked_raw)
109:     vm = report.get("version_manifest", {})
110:     require(vm.get("go_lock_sha256") == "sha256:" + digest(locked_raw), "GO_LOCK_PIN_MISMATCH")

134: def verify_owned(root, source, report, selected, owner):
135:     """Index each event by its real path and bind all assertion claims by ID."""
136:     owned = (root / source["report_reference"]).resolve(strict=True).parent / "owned"
137:     require(owned.is_dir() and not owned.is_symlink(), "OWNED_DIR_MISSING")
138:     claims = report.get("owned_export", {}).get("members")
139:     require(isinstance(claims, list) and claims, "OWNED_MANIFEST_MISSING")
140:     members, events = {}, {}
141:     opaque = ("http-request", "http-response", "file-body-", "g02-junction-stdout")
142:     for claim in claims:
143:         require(isinstance(claim, dict) and set(claim) == {"path", "sha256", "bytes"}, "OWNED_CLAIM_SHAPE")
144:         lexical = root / claim["path"]
145:         require(not lexical.is_symlink(), "OWNED_MEMBER_SYMLINK")
146:         path = lexical.resolve(strict=True)
147:         require(owned in path.parents and path not in members and not path.is_symlink()
148:                 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}-.+\.raw", path.name)
149:                 and path.parent.name in selected, "OWNED_FOREIGN_OR_DUPLICATE")
150:         data = path.read_bytes()
151:         require(claim == {"path": str(path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"),
152:                           "sha256": digest(data), "bytes": len(data)}, "OWNED_PIN_DRIFT")
153:         members[path] = claim
154:         label = path.name.split("-", 1)[1][:-4]
155:         if label.startswith(opaque) or label in A06_MANIFEST_RAW_LABELS or re.fullmatch(r"simulated-opinion-(?:0[0-9]|1[0-9])", label):
156:             continue
157:         item = json.loads(data)
158:         require(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("_run_id") == report["run_id"]
159:                 and item.get("_test_name") == path.parent.name, "EVENT_CURRENT_RUN_OR_OWNER_MISMATCH")
160:         events.setdefault(label, []).append({"value": item, "path": path, "pin": claim,
161:                                              "test": path.parent.name})
162:     require(set(members) == {p.resolve(strict=True) for p in owned.rglob("*.raw")}, "OWNED_SET_INCOMPLETE")
163:     require({p.parent.name for p in members} == {t for t in selected if t not in
164:             {"TestW09RootReadRejectsEscape", "TestW09RootIdentityRejectsReplacement"}}, "OWNED_TEST_SET_MISMATCH")
165:     for rec in report["assertion_results"]:
166:         aid = rec["assertion_id"]
167:         group = events.get("assertion-" + aid, [])
168:         require(len(group) == 1 and group[0]["test"] == owner[aid]
169:                 and rec.get("owned_export_ref") == {"path": str(group[0]["path"]),
170:                                                    "sha256": group[0]["pin"]["sha256"],
171:                                                    "bytes": group[0]["pin"]["bytes"]},
172:                 "ASSERTION_ID_PATH_PIN_MISMATCH")
173:         raw = group[0]["value"]
174:         require(raw.get("assertion_id") == aid and raw.get("actual") == rec.get("evidence")
175:                 and raw.get("status") == "PASS" and isinstance(raw.get("expected"), dict)
176:                 and all(raw["actual"].get(k) == v for k, v in raw["expected"].items()),
177:                 "ASSERTION_ACTUAL_EXPECTED_MISMATCH")
178:     return {"members": members, "events": events, "owned": owned}

552:     """A later non-author decision must bind this run; absent facts fail closed."""
553:     require(isinstance(decision_ref, str) and decision_ref and isinstance(decision_sha, str)

571:     reviewer_pin = decision.get("independent_review_ref")

573:             "INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_RECEIPT_MISSING")

578:     review = json.loads(reviewer_raw)

580:             and review.get("actor_id") == decision["reviewer_id"]

582:             and review.get("producer_id") == decision["producer_id"]

592:                 and all(x["value"].get("delivery") == "IN_PROCESS_HTTptest_RECORDER"
593:                         for x in ctx["events"].get("http-exchange", []))
594:                 and any(x["value"].get("root_path") and
595:                         Path(x["value"]["root_path"]).is_relative_to(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()))
596:                         for k, v in ctx["events"].items() if k.startswith("state-") for x in v),
597:                 "FIXTURE_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL")
598:     else:

614:             _, raw = safe_repo_pin(root, item)
615:             witness = json.loads(raw)

627:                 and isinstance(junction_event.get("root_path"), str)
628:                 and isinstance(junction_event.get("target_path"), str)
629:                 and Path(junction_event["root_path"]).is_absolute()

631:                 and junction_event["root_path"] != junction_event["target_path"]
632:                 and junction_event.get("command") == ["cmd.exe", "/c", "mklink", "/J",
